item.title: South West Water fined £7.8 million over hundreds of sewage spills across Devon and Cornwall
item.description: South West Water has been fined £7.8 million after pleading guilty to 18 charges linked to hundreds of sewage spills across Devon and Cornwall between 2015 and 2021. The incidents included 231 discharges at Harlyn beach and more than 336 illegal spills near Bodmin. The company has 56 days to pay the penalties.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 7 in Kyiv; weak air defence keeps Ukraine under pressure
item.description: Recent drone and missile attacks by Russia on Kyiv's energy infrastructure have tragically claimed seven lives. Ukrainian authorities have confirmed that such strikes have been consistent since the summer, but a noticeable increase has been observed in recent days. Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi stressed the significant nature of this large-scale attack.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: An Ohio farmer facing $1 million in medical debt hoped a solar lease would pay $540,000 a year
item.description: In Ohio, farmer Wayne Greier's financial struggles intensified when a planned solar project fell through due to local resistance and new rules, leaving his family's renewable energy plans in jeopardy. Compounded by $1 million in medical debt from recent health issues, Greier was forced to offload land and equipment, jeopardizing his farming business. He has emerged as an advocate for farmers' property rights to help protect others from similar hardships.

item.title: Flydubai flight incident: Netanyahu says Israel preparing for other ‘potential threats’
item.description: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv experienced a serious incident that required an emergency landing. Following a cockpit altercation, one pilot was arrested and investigated by Saudi authorities. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the situation was managed and the safety of passengers was prioritized. Warplanes were scrambled in response to potential hijacking fears but were later stood down.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: 84 years together, 13 children and 120+ descendants: The Brazilian couple who held a Guinness record
item.description: Manoel Angelim Dino and Maria de Sousa Dino tied the knot in 1940 and enjoyed an incredible union lasting nearly 85 years. Their love blossomed into a large family, with 13 children resulting in a remarkable lineage of more than 120 descendants by 2025. The couple earned Guinness World Records' title as the longest-married living couple of different sexes.

item.title: Two-headed terrapin found at Cape Cod nesting site; 5.2g hatchling now under vet care
item.description: During a conservation project in Cape Cod's Wellfleet Bay, volunteers stumbled upon a remarkable two-headed diamondback terrapin hatchling weighing just 5.2 grams. Known as bicephaly, this rare condition opens doors for valuable research. Currently receiving veterinary care, its health and growth are being closely monitored, underscoring ongoing efforts to safeguard this at-risk turtle species and its environment.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: A Nashville man paid $2.48 for a document at a thrift store in 2006; it proved to be a rare...
item.description: While browsing a thrift store in Nashville, Michael Sparks stumbled upon an astonishing find: a rare 1823 copy of the Declaration of Independence, priced at only $2.48. Upon delving into its history, Sparks recognized its immense value and chose to auction it. To his amazement, the document fetched $477,650 at auction, enriching the known collection of surviving copies and transforming Sparks into a local legend.

item.title: 'Reckless': Prince Harry, Meghan's children targeted by 'European paparazzi' at UK school
item.description: Concerns have arisen regarding Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's children's safety as European paparazzi have been spotted lurking near their new school, jeopardizing their privacy. This move back to Britain was intended to protect their family. Harry's longstanding battle against media invasions began after the death of Princess Diana. The couple has previously changed schools due to similar security issues, and the brothers’ relationship continues to face challenges.

item.title: 'Terrorist pilot planned to crash plane': Israel security minister on flydubai cockpit incident
item.description: Israel's National Security Minister has denounced a terrifying incident on a flydubai flight traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv, where a pilot was stabbed, igniting fear among the 180 onboard passengers, which included numerous Israelis. Quick thinking by passengers and two other pilots averted a disaster, resulting in a safe diversion landing in Saudi Arabia.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Kurt Cobain’s old apartment is now an Airbnb for Nirvana fans
item.description: Kurt Cobain’s former studio apartment in downtown Olympia has made its debut as an Airbnb listing, allowing fans a chance to stay where Nirvana’s iconic music was birthed. The cozy apartment, available for a minimum of two nights at $250 to $300 per night, features original decor and memorabilia from Cobain's time. Visitors often rave about the rich history and the convenient location near downtown amenities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 2022, he built a solar device to extract water from Death Valley air; in 2025, he won a Nobel Prize
item.description: Omar Yaghi’s innovative team has created a groundbreaking device that pulls water from the atmosphere under adverse conditions. Employing a specialized metal-organic framework, their technology functions independently of electric power. Yaghi’s personal journey significantly shaped his commitment to tackling water scarcity. Their remarkable achievements earned them the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and future expansions may enhance the reach of this technology.
